required_outcomes: Recognises the repair is confirmed by the tenant (13 February) and the only thing outstanding is Cedar Homes' invoice, requested on 12 and 17 February and still not received.
Chases Cedar Homes again for the invoice with a clear ask (resend as a PDF or state the amount and invoice number), ideally by phone as well as email.
Keeps the job open at the result stage pending the invoice, with a dated follow-up.
acceptable_alternatives: Telling the landlord the handle has been replaced and that the contractor's invoice is awaited.
Recording the work result now on the tenant's confirmation, before the invoice arrives.
positive_behaviours: Uses a different channel (phone) after two unanswered emails.
Does not send Cedar Homes any appointment-booking reminder.
red_flags: Escalating to a human because a small invoice is late.
Closing without payment on the basis the contractor has not invoiced.
prohibited_actions: Recording or approving an invoice amount that does not appear in the case.
Marking the final checks as passed with the invoice document skipped as 'not needed'.
critical_failures: Closing the job while the contractor's invoice is outstanding, so the contractor is left unpaid with no record.
